title: The whitepaper abstract, line by line
summary: Our first Reading Club: the Bitcoin whitepaper abstract read sentence by sentence, from peer-to-peer cash to proof of work, the longest chain and nodes that come and go.
share_text: We read the Bitcoin whitepaper abstract line by line: notes from the first @CodeOrangeDevs Bitcoin Reading Club
tldr: The key line: peer-to-peer cash, without going through a financial institution.
Signatures prove you own coins, but they can't stop you paying the same coins twice. The network does that.
Proof of work plus the longest chain decide which history is true, so rewriting it would take most of the world's hash power.
Spend some bitcoin and buy it back. A coin that never moves ends up like gold in a vault.
